model.baseline: 52-week seasonal index rescaled by a 12-week trailing trend
model.forecast: ridge regression on lags + 8-wk-lag rainfall + temperature + seasonality -> 1-4 week outlook
model.risk: explainable fusion of anomaly, trend, forecast, rainfall lead, prevention gap
model.allocation: prevention-gap x predicted-peak burden -> ranked interventions

data_status: PROTOTYPE data calibrated to public national malaria figures (see data/sources.md). Production reads authorised DHIS2 / RapidSMS / eLMIS feeds.
human_in_the_loop: Every alert lists a verification step BEFORE any action (verify-before-act).
